declarations.type:
∀ {Digest : Type} (current : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.RevisionedAdmissionState Digest)
  (proposal : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.MutationProposal Digest),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.CanCommit current proposal →
    proposal.expectedRevision = current.revision ∧
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.MutationAllowed current.state proposal.mutation
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.committable_proposal_has_exact_revision_and_allowed_mutation

declarations.type:
∀ {Digest : Type} (current : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.RevisionedAdmissionState Digest)
  (proposal : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.MutationProposal Digest)
  (allowed : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.CanCommit current proposal),
  (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.commit current proposal allowed).revision =
    current.revision + 1
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.committed_mutation_advances_revision_once

declarations.type:
∀ {Digest : Type} (current : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.RevisionedAdmissionState Digest)
  (proposal : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.MutationProposal Digest),
  proposal.expectedRevision < current.revision →
    ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.CanCommit current proposal
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.stale_revision_proposal_cannot_commit

declarations.type:
∀ {Digest : Type} (current : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.RevisionedAdmissionState Digest)
  (winner loser : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.MutationProposal Digest)
  (winnerAllowed : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.CanCommit current winner),
  loser.expectedRevision = current.revision →
    ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.CanCommit
        (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.commit current winner winnerAllowed) loser
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.same_snapshot_second_proposal_loses_revision_race

declarations.type:
∀ {Digest : Type} (current : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.RevisionedAdmissionState Digest)
  (claim : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinReplayProtection.AdmissionClaim Digest) (nextEpoch : Nat)
  (activationAllowed :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.CanCommit current
      (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.activationProposal current.revision claim)),
  ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.CanCommit
      (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.commit current
        (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.activationProposal current.revision claim)
        activationAllowed)
      (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.beginAttemptProposal current.revision nextEpoch)
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.concurrent_activation_and_epoch_advance_have_one_revision_winner

declarations.type:
∀ {Digest : Type} (current : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.RevisionedAdmissionState Digest)
  (claim : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinReplayProtection.AdmissionClaim Digest)
  (allowed :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.CanCommit current
      (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.activationProposal current.revision claim)),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.EdgeAuthorized
    (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.commit current
      (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.activationProposal current.revision claim) allowed)
    (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.activationEdge current claim)
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.activation_commit_authorizes_bound_graph_edge

declarations.type:
∀ {Digest : Type} (current : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.RevisionedAdmissionState Digest)
  (winner conflicting : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinReplayProtection.AdmissionClaim Digest)
  (allowed :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.CanCommit current
      (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.activationProposal current.revision winner)),
  winner.terminalDigest ≠ conflicting.terminalDigest →
    ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.EdgeAuthorized
        (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.commit current
          (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.activationProposal current.revision winner)
          allowed)
        { claim := conflicting, committedRevision := current.revision + 1 }
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.conflicting_claim_cannot_share_winner_edge

declarations.type:
∀ {Digest : Type} (current : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.RevisionedAdmissionState Digest)
  (edge : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.PublishedAdmissionEdge Digest),
  edge.committedRevision < current.revision →
    ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.EdgeAuthorized current edge
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinLinearization.stale_revision_edge_is_not_authorized
